0022600038.text: The Grizzlies (7-4, 5-0 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Pelicans (4-8, on a four-game losing streak) in the 12th game of Memphis's season, a West Group B Emirates NBA Cup matchup. Memphis trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 135-134 in Memphis on November 2, and the two teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2. The Grizzlies are without Richie Saunders (out, knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), and Quinten Post is day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), while Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), and Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions.
